flows.open_question: 04.9 volume for S-05 and the n8n folder for S-05 are not decided (04.9 Owner Alden; folders need the n8n UI). Until both are set here, P6/P8 block every new S-05 workflow.

non_idempotent.why: 07.06.1 A3 / 04.6 §3.5: retryOnFail only on idempotent nodes

checks.P1: Before any n8n write: every required_reads page and the flow's Spec and build sheet read in full (detail=full, every saved part printed) within read_max_age_min, at the latest version seen in this session.
checks.P2: 07.06.1 D2 / 04.6 §3.6 step 2: every jsCode in the call passes node --check, and no // comment sits after code on the same line.
checks.P3: 07.06.1 A3 / 04.6 §3.5: no retryOnFail on a non-idempotent node.
checks.P4: 07.06.1 E5: no setNodeCredential on an httpRequest node (API attachment of predefinedCredentialType is refused; attach in the UI).
checks.P5: 07.06.1 D5 (owner chose strict): before changing an existing workflow, (1) get_workflow_details of it after its last write, (2) that result saved byte-equal at snapshot_dir/<id>/<versionId>.json, (3) a successful Jira comment on the flow's feature ticket, after that read, containing the workflow id, the versionId and, for every setNodeParameter/updateNodeParameters op, the old value being replaced.
checks.P6: 04.9 §一 三位一体 / 07.06 §四-5 不得先建后补: a new workflow only when the flow's registry_volume is set and that page was read in full within the window.
checks.P7: 04.9 先登记后启用 / 04.6 §3.5 层一 / 04.6 §3.9: publish only when the workflow id is in a full read of 04.9 and of the volume after its last write, and its latest details show settings.errorWorkflow = error_workflow_id.
checks.P8: 04.6 §3.9: a new workflow is created with folderId = the flow's folder_id (must be set).
checks.S0: 07.06 §6.1-3: after the last successful write to a workflow, get_workflow_details of it (read-back).
checks.S1: 07.06.1 §六-1 / 04.6 §3.4-1: after the last write, a Jira comment on the feature ticket (or a draft whose G-01 ledger passes) containing the workflow id and the read-back versionId.
checks.S2: 04.9 §一: the workflow id in a full read of 04.9 after its creation, or a draft (G-01 ledger passes) containing the id and '04.9'.
checks.S3: 07.06 收口三件套: the workflow id in a full read of the build sheet after the last write, or a draft (G-01 ledger passes) containing the id.

known_limits: G-02 checks that the steps were taken and that the evidence exists; it does not judge whether a workflow's logic is right.
The flows table must be kept current; a workflow whose name matches no flow prefix is blocked (P1 cannot tell which Spec applies).
Hooks run as the same OS user as the model: they stop shortcuts and forgetting, not a deliberate attack.
